sources.title: The Brihat Jataka of Varaha Mihira
sources.author: Varahamihira
sources.edition: Foster Press, Madras, 1885 (archive.org scan brihatjatakavar00iyergoog, Google Books digitization)
sources.rights_basis: Sanskrit original is ancient. The English translation and notes were published in 1885, before 1929 (US public domain), and archive.org records possible-copyright-status NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT.
sources.notes: The archive.org OCR text layer is used; no new OCR is needed. Excerpts must fuzzy-match the segmented OCR of the cited verse, providing an automated provenance check, not a scholarly review. Chapters mapped: XIII, XIV, XVI, XVII and XX. Cross-checked 2026-10-02: Wellcome Collection identifies the same Foster Press 1885 edition with a Public Domain Mark: https://wellcomecollection.org/works/afmgm695 .

sources.title: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra (Sanskrit)
sources.author: Parashara

sources.notes: Milestone C3: pin a GRETIL or archive.org Sanskrit edition, then add an IAST-normalised rendering map.

sources.title: Bhrigu Sutras
sources.author: Bhrigu (attrib.)
sources.rights_basis: The original is public domain, but no pre-1929 English translation was located, and the common English editions are modern. Its graha-in-house aphorisms are covered by antariksha-authored-v1 and by Brihat Jataka ch. XX.
sources.notes: Bhrigu Samhita (a set of pre-written horoscopes) is out of scope. Sourcing check 2026-10-02: https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_z_misc_sociology_astrology/bhrigusUtram.html offers a Sanskrit transcription but its footer requires permission for commercial copying/reposting. Do not acquire or ingest that transcription without permission; locate a separately cleared edition. No Bhrigu text imported.

sources.title: Lal Kitab (five original volumes)
sources.author: Rup Chand Joshi (attributed)
sources.edition: 1939, 1940, 1941, 1942 and 1952 editions; edition and rights require review
sources.rights_basis: No text ingested. These 20th-century editions are not treated as public domain. Author attribution and term, edition provenance, Indian/Pakistani/US rights and publisher permissions require specialist review. A digital scan is not a commercial reuse license.
sources.notes: Separate school and vocabulary from Parashari. Copyright Office of India 2024 application list includes a Lal Kitab titled ILM SAMUNDRIK KI LAL KITAB KE FARMAN 1939; an application is not a final ownership ruling. Source: https://copyright.gov.in/Documents/New_Applications/New_Applications_November_2024.pdf

sources.title: The Brihat Samhita of Varaha Mihira
sources.author: Varahamihira
sources.edition: South Indian Press, Madura, 1884 (archive.org scan bihatsahitvarah00iyergoog, Google Books digitization, Harvard copy)
sources.rights_basis: Sanskrit original is ancient. The English translation was published in 1884 (US public domain: published before 1931) and the translator died long before 1965 (India: life + 60). archive.org records possible-copyright-status NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT.
sources.notes: Mundane astrology, omens, muhurta, marriage, gems and portents. Used as training text; not yet mapped to engine tokens. Split with segment=loose: many verse numbers are lost to OCR, and the second part restarts Roman chapter numbers with the standard number in brackets.

sources.title: The Brihat Sanhita of Varaha-Mihira (partial translation)
sources.author: Varahamihira
sources.edition: Journal of the Royal Asiatic Society, 1865 onwards (archive.org scan wg1077)
sources.rights_basis: Published 1865; the translator Hendrik Kern died in 1917. Public domain in the US and India.
sources.notes: Prose translation of the early chapters with an introduction; verse numbering is sparse in the OCR. Used as training text.

sources.title: The Brihat Jataka of Varaha Mihira (2nd edition)
sources.author: Varahamihira
sources.rights_basis: Second edition of the 1885 translation, published 1905 (US: before 1931); the translator died long before 1965 (India: life + 60). archive.org records NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT.
sources.notes: A second scan of the same translation: independent OCR for cross-checking the 1885 excerpts. Used as training text.

sources.title: The Brihajjatakam of Varaha Mihira
sources.author: Varahamihira
sources.edition: Sacred Books of the Hindus vol. XII, Panini Office, Allahabad, 1912 (archive.org scan b3136259x_0001, Wellcome Collection copy)
sources.rights_basis: Published 1912 (US public domain: before 1931). The translator died in 1938, so the translation entered the public domain in India in 1999 (life + 60). The holding library labels the scan 'In Copyright' as a precaution; that label is not a rights claim.
sources.notes: Sanskrit text with English translation and notes from Bhattotpala and other commentaries. Used as training text.
